scope: Complete proposed source scan, including untracked protected files.

findings.decision: Intentional portable Markdown path normalization: both slash spellings become Git repository slash paths, followed by repository containment checks.
The same backslash normalization is input handling, not a machine-specific filesystem location.
Explicitly rejects drive-qualified and UNC local Markdown targets on every host; negative public validator tests cover this guard.

tests: 15 delivery and encoding self-tests passed before this review.
